name: wps7
description: Portable Windows web tmux-continuum style terminal workspace.

scripts.package:win: pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/wps7.exe && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item 'dist\scripts\scripts','dist\assets\assets','dist\tools\tools' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory dist\scripts,dist\assets,dist\tools -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item start-wps7.vbs dist\start-wps7.vbs -Force; Copy-Item scripts\* dist\scripts -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item assets\* dist\assets -Recurse -Force; if (Test-Path tools) { Copy-Item tools\* dist\tools -Recurse -Force }"
